Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format all the variables (see the example on that page).

Constraints
* Please reduce the upper bound to 1000 as C never exceeds 1000.

All sections vs Stub generator
* Please use the same variable name: either "C" or "chocolates".

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Game modes
* Consider disabling Reverse mode as it's difficult to infer the task from the visible tests alone.

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario but with slightly different inputs. Please revise all validators accordingly.

Thanks.

Thank you for taking the time to review the puzzle and provide such detailed feedback. I really appreciate it.

I'll update the formatting, constraints, variable names, stub generator, and game mode based on your suggestions.

I had one question regarding the test cases: when you mention that each test and its validator should cover the same scenario with slightly different inputs, do you mean that the validator should use the exact same logic as the corresponding test case, with only the input values changed? I just wanted to confirm that I've understood this correctly before updating them.

Thanks again for your guidance!

Yes, that's right. The magnitudes of the input and output should be similar as well. For example, if input for a test is a 1-digit integer, the input for the corresponding validator should also be a 1-digit integer.

By the way, there's some duplication in the second and third paragraphs in the Goal section. Consider removing the second paragraph.
Thanks for the clarification! I've made the changes accordingly. Please let me know if there is any further change required.

All sections vs Stub generator
* Please use the same variable name in all the sections (including the stub generator): either "C" or "chocolates".

Cases
* These cases are the same:
  • Validator 2 & Test 4
  • Test 3 & Validator 4

All cases should be different, which every test and its corresponding validator should be similar.

Also, there are currently no cases with 2-digit integers as inputs.

Please revise the cases accordingly.

Thanks.
Thanks for the clarification! I've revised the cases accordingly. Please let me know if there is any further change required.

* The boundary immediately after a skipped jersey should be covered within a case pair. This is represented in Validator 2, so change the input of Test 2 from 126 to 201 to complete the pair.

* Test pairs should be arranged in increasing order of difficulty and input magnitude. Move Test 4 and Validator 4 so that they appear between Pair 1 and Pair 2.

* Consider adding Test 5 (720) and Validator 5 (405) to cover the boundary immediately before skipping a jersey number.

* Consider adding Test 6 (981) and Validator 6 (935) to cover values of C near its maximum possible limit.

Thanks.
Thanks again! I've revised the cases accordingly. Please let me know if there is any further change required.
That should be all for now. Thank you! 🙂
Thanks a lot for your effort! Also how does the approval flow work here. It my first time contributing, so let me know if anything needs to be done from my end to get this approved.
